serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: After the last improvement, I can’t just stop. I don’t know what’s going on in my head, but it’s clear the joint is doing something. Before I went to check if I still could cast that far even after all the drugs left my system, I could! It wasn’t luck, a performance enhancer, or a placebo. This shit is real. Mrs. Fisher knows all kinds of stuff. It might be weird, but who am I to doubt her? She’s been doing it for much longer than me. The sole fact that I think it’s weird just proves I’m still a greenhorn. I’m sure all fishers smoke one out from time to time. Or maybe not… {{wi}}I have no idea what to believe in, but I do want to get better at fishing, and that’s the only path I see forward. Let’s do this! You: I’m ready for another session. #mrsfisher.Face.Normal Mrs. Fisher: Here you go. Mrs. Fisher: Quite eager recently, aren’t ya? You: You think? Mrs. Fisher: I know I told you that it’s not addictive, but just to make sure… You: Are you kidding me? It smells like rotten fish and old socks. There’s no way for anyone to get addicted to this thing. #mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin Mrs. Fisher: Well, it is an acquired taste, I guess. A kid like you wouldn’t be able to appreciate it. She must be joking, but I can’t tell for sure. She smiled while saying it, but she is crazy enough to be saying this seriously. #mrsfisher.Face.Normal You: I hope I will never acquire that taste then. Mrs. Fisher: It’s not like something like this ever stopped a junkie. In some poor countries, they get high on fermented shit and piss. You: What the fuck? Mrs. Fisher: ‘Nough with the chit-chat, take a puff and shut up. I want to go back to fishing. You: Sure… #mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry You: {{punch}}Cough, cough! You: Somehow it's worse than before… Mrs. Fisher: You disappoint me, boy. See ya in a few hours.
